short_description: Guided 1.5-mile walking chocolate tour of Beacon Hill and downtown Boston with multiple tastings and local stories.
cancellation_summary: Full refund if canceled at least 48 hours before the tour start; otherwise no refund.
meeting_point: Please meet your guide outside of Beacon Hill Chocolates at 91 Charles Street in Boston, MA in the Beacon Hill neighborhood.
pricing:
* Both non-refundable and refundable ticket options available
* All guests must purchase a ticket in advance
description: Delve into the sophisticated world of chocolate as you stroll Boston’s most beautiful streets with a friendly, knowledgeable guide. This 1.5-mile tour moves through Beacon Hill, Boston Common, Park Street and the Boston Public Market while you sample a variety of bean-to-bar chocolates, unique truffles, a Belgian tasting, chocolate tea and Boston’s original Boston Cream Pie. The experience blends local history, small-business stories and generous tastings for a fun outing for locals and visitors alike.

what_is_included_items.value: Visit Beacon Hill, Boston Common, Downtown Boston, and Boston Public Market with a friendly guide
Five stops with chocolate samples from mostly female-owned small businesses
Confirmation of substitutions for dietary restrictions or allergies via email
Boston digital guide sent to guests after the tour

itinerary:
1. Historical guided tour through Beacon Hill and downtown Boston
2. Chocolate samples and tastings at five stops
3. Savor a unique chocolate truffle, imported gelato, locally roasted cacao beans and dried cacao fruit
4. Enjoy a chocolate tea paired with an artisanal chocolate bar
5. Walk through Boston Common and view landmarks including the Embrace statue and State House
6. Delight in Boston’s original Boston Cream Pie
7. Bon bon and mexican chocolate almonds at the Boston Public Market
8. Surprises and stories throughout the tour
highlights:
* Guided bean-to-bar chocolate experience with generous samples
* Tastings from mostly female-owned local businesses, from truffles to bon bons and a unique chocolate tea
* Scenic walk along Beacon Hill and other photographic streets with local history and stories
* Suitable for celebrations, date nights, families and visitors looking for a unique Boston experience
highlight_description:
* Stroll through historic Boston while being entertained by a seasoned guide all about chocolate bean to bar.
* Delight in the most delicious high quality chocolate treats from bon bons to cookies.
check_in_details: Meet your guide outside Beacon Hill Chocolates at 91 Charles Street in Boston’s Beacon Hill neighborhood. You will receive an email the week of the tour with exact guide contact information; the guide will be holding a binder with the company logo and will call or text if you do not see the group.

what_to_bring_items.value: Cash or Venmo for guide gratuity (suggested $10–20 per guest)

special_requirements:
* Children under age 12 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.
* Email to request private tour pricing.
* If you test positive for COVID, email to reschedule the tour at least 14 days later.
restrictions:
* Tour involves the ability to walk at least 2 miles at a leisurely pace.
* Cannot accommodate gluten- or dairy-free allergies at every stop; risk of cross-contamination for other allergies due to small kitchen sizes.
* Dogs are not allowed inside restaurants; service animals are permitted (service-dog guidance available).
extras: Private tours and translator services may be available upon request; email for details.
disclaimers: See waiver for full details. Guests assume all risks.

faq_items.question: Where do I meet the tour guide?
faq_items.answer: You will be sent an email the week of the tour with exact meeting information and the guide's cell phone number.

faq_items.question: Do tours run rain or shine?
faq_items.answer: Yes, tours run rain or shine.

faq_items.question: Can my dog come on the tour?
faq_items.answer: Dogs are not allowed inside the restaurants; service dogs are allowed or you may remain outside while someone else collects samples.

faq_items.question: Do you have child pricing?
faq_items.answer: There is one set of prices for all guests; the restaurants charge the same amount regardless of guest age.

faq_items.question: Do you do anything special for birthdays?
faq_items.answer: Yes; email to request additional services for private tour birthday groups.

faq_items.question: How do I give you a positive 5-star review?
faq_items.answer: We encourage guests to write about their positive tour experience on review sites and help spread the word about our tours.

faq_items.question: Are you the best tour in Boston?
faq_items.answer: The operator states they are and look forward to hosting you.
